components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Kinetic-orange primary action; once per decision cluster.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(61.7% 0.205 37.4); color: oklch(17.8% 0 89.9); border: 1px solid oklch(61.7% 0.205 37.4); border-radius: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 400 15px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(68% 0.19 37.4); border-color: oklch(68% 0.19 37.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(61.7% 0.205 37.4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered control for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(97.8% 0.002 89.9); color: oklch(17.8% 0 89.9); border: 1px solid oklch(92.8% 0.006 264.5); border-radius: 10px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 400 15px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(96.5% 0.006 264.5); border-color: oklch(85% 0.008 264); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(61.7% 0.205 37.4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live Badge
components.description: Mono status chip with kinetic orange signal dot.
components.css: .ds-live-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: oklch(97.8% 0.002 89.9); color: oklch(17.8% 0 89.9); border: 1px solid oklch(92.8% 0.006 264.5); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 500 11px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-live-badge__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(61.7% 0.205 37.4); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat bordered surface; no resting shadow.
components.html:
Panel

Calm surface for grouped content.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(97.8% 0.002 89.9); color: oklch(17.8% 0 89.9); border: 1px solid oklch(92.8% 0.006 264.5); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 18px/1.1 "Syne Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card__body { margin: 0; font: 400 15px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: oklch(52.1% 0.008 88.7); }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio inherits Omar Hosam's technical editorial identity: a near-white working surface, near-black framing, cool-gray structure, compact technical typography, and one kinetic orange signal. Interfaces stay calm so authored moments — mark, bilingual lockup, primary action — remain recognizable.

Engineering reads as deliberate systems craft. Egyptian and Arabic point of view is carried by typography and rhythm (Syne + IBM Plex + Noto Sans Arabic), never by decorative cultural shorthand.
keyCharacteristics: One orange accent reserved for state, progress, and primary action
Compact Latin display type paired with comfortably led Arabic
Flat surfaces, fine rules, and selective structural depth
One forward-building motion language derived from the mark
shadcn/ui primitives themed to the broadcast tokens (light + dark)

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is kinetic, not decorative. Use it to communicate live state, progress, one primary action, or a deliberate interruption; otherwise ration it.

rules.name: The Full-Field Exception
rules.body: A full orange background is reserved for high-recognition interruption states. It is not a routine content background.

rules.name: The Separate Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Do not compress Arabic into Syne's tight Latin rhythm. Set lang="ar", use right-to-left direction, keep letter spacing at zero, and give the Arabic name its own comfortably led line or block.

rules.name: The Short Display Rule
rules.body: Large Syne headlines are terse and architectural. Move explanations into body copy.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Apply shadow only where one functional layer overlaps another. Resting controls, navigation, and ordinary cards remain flat.

rules.name: The Intact Mark Rule
rules.body: The dot and both slashes are one indivisible signature. Animation may sequence their arrival; layout and color may not separate them.

dos: Do use orange for live state, progress, one primary action, or a deliberate interruption
Do keep Arabic on its own right-to-left, comfortably led line or block
Do keep resting UI flat; reserve shadow for functional overlap
Do retain keyboard navigation, 44px targets, visible focus, and reduced-motion settle behavior
Do theme shadcn primitives from these tokens — do not introduce a second palette
donts: Don't recolor individual mark pieces or use orange as routine decoration / default content background
Don't force Arabic into Latin tracking, leading, alignment, or typeface conventions
Don't add gradients, glass effects, ornamental jargon, or decorative shadows
Don't fabricate metrics, customers, testimonials, audience claims, or technical proof
Don't use Geist, Inter, or other default stacks as the brand voice
